```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(mgcv)
library(DHARMa)
library(mgcViz)
library(ggeffects)
```


#Modelling the environmental variables

##Loading in the data
```{r Loading in the data}
env_mod_data <- read_csv(here("./03_clean_data/urch_sn_ratio_mod_data.csv"))
```

```{r Scaling the explanatory variables and converting substrate type to factor}
env_mod_data$sst_scale <- scale(env_mod_data$sst)
env_mod_data$avg_fetch_scale <- scale(env_mod_data$avg_fetch)
env_mod_data$dominant_score <- as.factor(env_mod_data$dominant_score)
```

##Plotting EVs against urch sn ratio

```{r ratio against fetch}
ggplot(env_mod_data, aes(x = avg_fetch_scale, y = urch_sn_ratio))+
  geom_point()+
  theme.figure()
```

```{r ratio against sst}
ggplot(env_mod_data, aes(x = sst_scale, y = urch_sn_ratio))+
  geom_point()+
  theme.figure()
```

```{r ratio against substrate type}
ggplot(env_mod_data, aes(x = dominant_score, y = urch_sn_ratio))+
  geom_point()+
  theme.figure()
```

##Building the GAM

```{r Making a gam with no spatial autocorrelation term to start}
env_mod <- gam(urch_sn_ratio ~ s(sst_scale, k = 11) + s(avg_fetch_scale), data = env_mod_data, method = 'REML', select = TRUE)

gam.check(env_mod, rep = 100)

```

```{r Checking the model fit with DHARMa}
env_mod_resids <- simulateResiduals(env_mod)
plot(env_mod_resids)
```

```{r Plotting the model output}
gratia::draw(env_mod)
```


###Visualizing the model output
```{r}
plot(ggeffects::ggpredict(env_mod), facets = TRUE)
```

####Using ggpredict to get predicted values for each EV
```{r Using ggpredict to predict values for the EVs}
pred_env_data <- ggpredict(env_mod, terms = "sst_scale", "avg_fetch_scale", "dominant_score")%>%
  as.data.frame()
```

```{r}
ggplot(env_mod_data, aes(x = sst_scale, y = urch_sn_ratio))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_line(aes(y = predict(env_mod, new_data = env_mod_data)), colour = "blue")+
  theme.figure()
```


```{r}
ggplot(env_mod_data, aes(x = avg_fetch_scale, y = urch_sn_ratio))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_line(aes(y = predict.gam(env_mod, new_data = env_mod_data)), colour = "blue")+
  theme.figure()
```
